items.title: Festive Clothing
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Mannequins? Festive jumpers? It's that time of the year again! Express your jovial spirits with your newfound looks! Become an elf, reindeer, or even a nutcracker using this brand-new skin pack! Get ready to celebrate the merriest day of the year! 

+ 10 festive-themed skins
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Igonomic.

items.title: Holiday Knights
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Celebrate the holidays in your kingdom as a knight in festive armor! ‘Tis the most wonderful time of the year!

- 6 HD merry knight skins!
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from The Pocalypse Studios.

items.title: Holiday Animals
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ready for the holiday season? Well, we are! Enjoy the holidays with these frozen, festive animal skins, ranging from cute bears to cuddly penguins.

+ 10 holiday-themed skins
+ Great for roleplay!
+ Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Environ Studios.

items.title: Icy Winter Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Winter is here! It's getting really cold and icy out there. With these 10 super-awesome outfits to wear with your friends, you will be nice and warm while exploring any cold mountains ahead of you!

- 10 AWESOME winter skins
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Perfect Luxury Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Do you like luxury brands? Are you a cool gamer? So show it with these new Perfect Luxury Teens skins and be the coolest player in your favourite servers!
Choose the outfit of you dreams and show to the world your fashion taste!

- 11 fashion skins
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Colored Sleeves
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
What is your favorite sleeve color? Choose the one that makes you coolest and go to your favorite servers to show your style!

- 7 colorful skins
- Perfect for role-playing!
- By Pixelusion & SucreGappySan

items.title: Medieval Red Village
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Have lots of adventures with your besties in this picturesque village. Settle into cozy houses providing protection from the monsters that can threaten you at night. Rumor has it that there's treasure hidden here.

- Cute village houses
- Hidden treasure
- Perfect for starting survival
- Includes 3 skins
- Licensed by BreadBuilds and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Skyblock Challenge
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Everyone loves SKYBLOCK!
Build from island to island and think carefully about how to use the few resources provided. Can you defeat the Ender Dragon? 

+Single and multiplayer friendly
+Classic skyblock experience

items.title: Rising Lava Challenge
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
Can you escape the rising lava by gathering resources and building into the sky? Customize the map and speed of the rising lava to challenge yourself or your friends!

- 2 Gamemodes: vanilla and sky islands
- 6 Different maps
- Map customizer (build your own maps)
- Change the lava rising speed to slow, normal or fast
- Singleplayer and multiplayer

items.title: Enchanted Armor
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Are you ready to show off your enchanted new armor skins? Well then this skin pack is just for you! Show off with your epic purple glowing armor and vanquish anyone who gets in your way! Become the warrior you were meant to be with these outfits!

- 10 enchanted themed skins!
- 1 free skin!
- No real armor included!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Royal Teen Family
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Dream of ruling your own kingdom as a king or queen in these fashionable new skins! Wear your lavishing, shiny and powerful crowns and show everyone how you rule in survival and PVP! Become Royalty in Minecraft with these hot outfits! 

- 9 royal skins!
- 1 free skin! 
- Perfect for you and friend's!
- By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Pink Goth
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: Wear pink while the squad games! Great goth and emo skins!

items.title: Masked Teens
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The group of masked teens is looking for new members and it just so happens you have been chosen! Now pick up a mask and become a member of the elite and stylish and trendy group that dominates in all the favorite gamemodes like skyblock, parkour, and lucky block!

- 10 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Winter Aliens
items.creator: CrackedCubes
items.description:
What if Santa and his elves were actually from space? Help create presents in extra-terrestrial style this holiday season with help from your friends. Be careful though, as not all intergalactic species are friendly... One free winter alien skin included.
From the team at CrackedCubes

items.title: Christmas Classic
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description: Merry Christmas!! Enjoy your holiday season with these classic Christmas skins!

items.title: Tree Camo HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Climb through the trees, shuffle in the leaves, and hop over the bushes with this cool camo styled skin pack! When you wear these high definition skins, you can be one with the forest and surprise your friends. Fun for roleplays, mini games, and basic survival.

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Power Bingo
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
BINGO!
This reimagined version of Bingo brings power-ups, unique maps, and a lot of fun!

+ 15 Power-ups
+ Unlock epic loot
+ Singleplayer or multiplayer so bring a friend!
+ Custom options

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: World of Magic: Dragon Knight
items.creator: Cyclone
items.description:
Become a student of magic once more and discover the mystical world of the Masra Kingdom! Endless, scorching deserts, dangerous canyons and dense jungles await your magical adventure filled with pyramids, tombs and the ancient spells of a fallen kingdom.
+ 12 New, unique Spells!
+ A huge, open world!
+ Epic Dungeons, Quests & Boss fights!
+ Custom mobs, music & textures!

items.title: Cozy Animals
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Winter's coming, so it's time to get out your sweaters and dress up all cosy! What better way to do it than with the Cosy Animals skin pack? Don't go into hibernation though, there's mining to do!

- 10 skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Crazy Diamonds
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Diamond blocks are amazing, so why not become one?

+ 7 wild skins
+ Super random outfits

items.title: Camo Skins!
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: Ever wanted to hide in the shadows? Well now you can! Camouflage yourself amongst the trees or blend in with stone in a cave. Perfect for winning hide and seek.

items.title: Armored NINJA
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Live a life as a ninja in the modern world!

- 8 different types of a total of 20 HD skins
- A Cyber-ninja themed design
- A team of 5 colorful ninjas
- Your enemy is a double-crossing robot

Creator: MOL BOX

items.title: Fall Mobs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
These mobs are dressing for the season. Which shows off your style the best?

* 12 mob skins
* 1 skin free

items.title: Cutest Anime Fashion
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
You'll dazzle everyone with the cutest anime skins ever! Pick your favorite skin from this amazing pack now and start glowing!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay
